PaymentService/Authorize.no3ds_auto_capture_google_pay_encrypted: The scenario's token is placeholder text, and a usable one cannot be committed: a real Google Pay token must be minted in a browser and carries a messageExpiration, so a fixture would rot. It also has to be minted against gatewayMerchantId = the account's Authorize.Net gatewayId (not the API Login ID) or Authorize.Net decrypts it and then rejects the merchant binding with 153 "Invalid ownership". Verified against the sandbox by grpcurl instead: Authorize responseCode 1, transId 80060702606 through UCS and 80060702659 through hyperswitch -> UCS.
PaymentService/Authorize.no3ds_auto_capture_google_pay_decrypted: authorizedotnet is PSP-decryption only: it accepts the wallet token as an opaqueData passthrough and decrypts it itself, so the dashboard pins payment_processing_details_at to "Connector" and a pre-decrypted token is rejected at transformation. Hyperswitch's Direct integration rejects it the same way.
